name: Liverpool
headline: Who would you rather watch the match with?
subline: Pick your matchday companion. The Reds decide the ranking.

cards.name: Kenny Dalglish
cards.tagline: Sees the pass before it happens and says nothing.

cards.name: Steven Gerrard
cards.tagline: Never stops believing, especially at 3-0 down.

cards.name: Ian Rush
cards.tagline: Waits for the one chance, then settles it.

cards.name: John Barnes
cards.tagline: Cool, smooth, and never flustered.

cards.name: Luis Suarez
cards.tagline: Wins every duel and argues every decision.

cards.name: Mohamed Salah
cards.tagline: Silent until the goal, then the whole room chants his name.

cards.name: Robbie Fowler
cards.tagline: The fans call him God, and he celebrates like one.

cards.name: Jamie Carragher
cards.tagline: Shouts at every defender like he is still on the pitch.

cards.name: Virgil van Dijk
cards.tagline: Calm, composed, and never lunges.

cards.name: Roberto Firmino
cards.tagline: Smiles, works harder than anyone, and wants everyone involved.

cards.name: Bill Shankly
cards.tagline: Makes you feel this match matters more than anything.

cards.name: Bob Paisley
cards.tagline: Says very little and wins everything.

cards.name: Jurgen Klopp
cards.tagline: Hugs everyone at the final whistle, win or lose.

cards.name: Rafael Benitez
cards.tagline: Has a note for every set piece and shares it at half-time.

cards.name: Gerard Houllier
cards.tagline: Calm, thoughtful, and happy to explain the long game.

cards.name: Joe Fagan
cards.tagline: Quiet, modest, and quietly wins a treble.

cards.name: Roy Evans
cards.tagline: Wants entertaining football and a good time after.

cards.name: Brendan Rodgers
cards.tagline: Talks about the process through every near miss.

cards.name: Ronnie Moran
cards.tagline: Has been at the club for decades and tells you every story.

cards.name: Phil Thompson
cards.tagline: Passionate, loud, and certain about every decision.

cards.name: Daniel Craig
cards.tagline: Never spills his drink, however tense it gets.

cards.name: LeBron James
cards.tagline: Studies every pass like it is a play from the playbook.

cards.name: Samuel L. Jackson
cards.tagline: Delivers every opinion at full volume and full conviction.

cards.name: Liam Neeson
cards.tagline: Calm voice, intense stare, and a particular set of opinions.

cards.name: Mike Myers
cards.tagline: Does the voices, the chants, and the accents.

cards.name: Dr. Dre
cards.tagline: Brings the music for the walk to the ground.

cards.name: Lana Del Rey
cards.tagline: Quiet, moody, and cheers only at the best moments.

cards.name: Millie Bobby Brown
cards.tagline: Loud, excited, and thrilled to be there.

cards.name: Clive Owen
cards.tagline: Calm narrator, calm commentary, calm even at 90 minutes.

cards.name: Angelina Jolie
cards.tagline: Quiet, focused, and always has the best seat.
